Bahurajjuke.g: idaṁ kāyabandhanaṁ sandhāya vuttaṁ, na dasā sandhāya.

Bahurajā.g: vātapaharaṇakāle uddhatena rajakkhandhena pariyonaddhā viya hoti.

Bahuraja.g: vātapaharaṇakāle uddhatena rajakkhandhena pariyonaddhā viya hoti.

Bahuratano.g: bahūnaṁ dhammaratanānaṁ ākarattā anekavidharatanasampanno mahāsamuddo viya bahuratano sāgarasadiso.
